text: dsh-gh-search 是面向 DSH Web 客户端的 GitHub 搜索与查看工具。它向 DSH 注册 gh_search 和 gh_view 两个工具，通过本机 GitHub CLI 搜索 issue、PR、commit、仓库和代码，并读取单个 issue 或 PR 的标题、状态、正文、作者、标签及评论。适合在编码会话中查找 GitHub 讨论和查看变更上下文。需要本机安装并认证 gh；可选设置 PI_GH_TOKEN。

dsh-gh-search adds gh_search and gh_view tools to DSH. Using the local GitHub CLI, it searches issues, pull requests, commits, repositories, and code, and shows issue or PR details including body, labels, and comments. Install and authenticate gh; PI_GH_TOKEN is optional.
想在 DSH 会话里搜索 GitHub issue、PR 或代码。
怎样从 DSH 查看某个 GitHub issue 或拉取请求的详情？
Search GitHub issues, pull requests, repositories, commits, or code from a DSH session.
dsh-gh-search 的功能「GitHub 内容搜索」：通过 gh_search 按 GitHub 查询语法搜索 issue、PR、commit、仓库或代码，并返回精简匹配列表；可设置结果上限。
dsh-gh-search 的功能「查看 issue 或 PR」：通过 gh_view 输入编号、owner/repo#N 或 GitHub URL，读取标题、状态、正文、作者、标签和可选评论。

dsh-gh-search README · dsh-gh-search：> **English** · [中文](README.zh.md)

GitHub issue/PR **search** and **view** tools for [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness),
backed by the [GitHub CLI](https://cli.github.com/) (`gh`).

dsh-gh-search README · dsh-gh-search：> ⚠️ **Personal / unofficial.** This is a personal plugin **ported from
> [oh-my-pi](https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi)'s `gh-search` / `gh-view`
> (via the `pi-gh` extension)**. It is **not** a DeepSeek official plugin and
> intentionally does **not** re-implement the full `gh` CLI — it only packages
> search & view for convenience inside agent sessions.

Registers two tools:

dsh-gh-search README · dsh-gh-search：| Tool | Purpose |
|---|---|
| **`gh_search`** | Search GitHub issues / PRs / commits / repos / code with GitHub search syntax |
| **`gh_view`** | View a single issue or PR in detail (title, state, body, author, labels, comments) |

dsh-gh-search README · Dependencies：- **No third-party npm runtime dependency.** The only `peerDependencies`
  (`@deepseek-ai/dsh-tools`, `@deepseek-ai/cordis`) are resolved from the DSH
  environment that already loads this plugin — nothing extra to install.
- **System dependency:** the GitHub CLI (`gh`) must be installed and
  authenticated:

```bash
winget install GitHub.cli
gh auth login
```

dsh-gh-search README · Dependencies：`gh` authenticates via the `GITHUB_TOKEN` / `GH_TOKEN` environment variable.
This plugin drops both from the child process so `gh` falls back to its stored
login (and honors `PI_GH_TOKEN` if set).

dsh-gh-search README · `gh_search`：- `query` (string, required) — GitHub search syntax, e.g. `repo:owner/name is:open label:bug`.
- `searchType` (string) — `issues` \| `prs` \| `commits` \| `repos` \| `code` (default `issues`).
- `limit` (integer) — max results (default 10, max 50).

dsh-gh-search README · `gh_view`：- `identifier` (string, required) — issue/PR number, `owner/repo#N`, or full URL.
- `objectType` (string) — `issue` \| `pr` (default auto).
- `repo` (string) — owner/repo when `identifier` is a bare number.
- `includeComments` (boolean) — include comments (default true).

dsh-gh-search README · Install：Wired into the `web` profile as `file:./plugins/dsh-gh-search` (`dsh.profile.bundles`
+ `dependencies`). To re-install after a fresh profile:

```sh
dsh plugin --profile web install
```

If you add it to an already-running profile, one `dsh web` restart is needed to
load it (after that, `dsh-reload`'s `/reload dsh-gh-search` hot-mounts new edits
without a restart).
